providers.title: Closures, groupings and moments of free families
providers.scope: Freeness of unital *-subalgebras passes to the generated von Neumann algebras and to groupings, and mixed moments are determined by the restrictions of the trace.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Conjugation by the other algebra
providers.scope: If A and B are free and U in B is unitary, then UAU* and B are free, with the same mixed moments.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Normal form in free groups
providers.scope: Every element of F_d has exactly one reduced word, and homomorphisms from F_d may take arbitrary values on the generators.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Free group factors
providers.scope: F_d is ICC for d >= 2, so L(F_d) is a II_1 factor.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Identification by a Haar tuple
providers.scope: A freely generating Haar d-tuple U in (M, tau) gives a unique normal trace-preserving isomorphism L(F_d) -> M with lambda(x_j) -> U_j; the word algebra of U is dense in L^2(M).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Changes of Haar tuples
providers.scope: Two freely generating Haar tuples differ by a trace-preserving automorphism, automorphisms of F_d act on Haar tuples, and the components are free Haar unitaries.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Free conjugates
providers.scope: For a freely generating Haar tuple (A_1, ..., A_n, C) and S = arg C, the algebras A_g W*(C) A_g*, g in F_n, are free.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Group labels
providers.scope: Products of A_j, A_j* and S with nonidentity label have trace 0; those with identity label are products of conjugates S_g.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Norm of a free sum
providers.scope: For centred self-adjoint z_j in free von Neumann subalgebras, ||sum z_j|| <= 2 (sum ||z_j||_2^2)^(1/2) + max ||z_j||.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Free sums of conjugates
providers.scope: ||sum_g k(g) A_g S A_g*|| <= 3 pi ||k||_l2 for finitely supported real k.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Cocycles on the free group
providers.scope: Generator values h_1, ..., h_n extend uniquely to D with D_(gb) = D_g + lambda(g) D_b.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The formal derivation
providers.scope: delta z = 0 and delta a_j = i sigma(h_j) a_j define a *-derivation with delta a_g = i sigma(D_g) a_g and delta z_g = i [sigma(D_g), z_g], preserving labels.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Trace identity at time zero
providers.scope: tau(ev_0(delta^r p)) = 0 for every formal polynomial p and every r >= 1.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Global unitary solutions
providers.scope: The polynomial equation X_j' = i H_j(X) X_j has a unique global solution in every norm-closed *-subalgebra containing S, and it stays unitary.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Moment invariance
providers.scope: All moments of the moving tuple together with S are constant in time.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Norm from moments
providers.scope: ||b|| = lim tau((b*b)^k)^(1/2k) in a von Neumann algebra with faithful tracial state.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Trace-preserving polynomial flows
providers.scope: A one-parameter group of trace-preserving normal automorphisms fixing S and C, with ||beta_t(A_j) - A_j|| <= 3 pi |t| ||h_j|| and ||beta_t(A_w) - exp(itS) A_w|| <= 3 pi |t| ||D_w - delta_e||.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Free prefixes
providers.scope: p_j = (x_1 b_1)...(x_1 b_j), b_j = x_2^j x_3 x_2^(-j), freely generate a free subgroup of F_n (n >= 3).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Cocycle of the prefix word
providers.scope: D_(w_m) = T_m h for w_m = p_m x_1 and T_m = sum_(j<=m) lambda(p_j).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Noncrossing reductions
providers.scope: A word in which each free generator occurs twice with opposite exponents is trivial exactly when its matching is noncrossing.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Catalan numbers
providers.scope: There are (2r)!/(r!(r+1)!) noncrossing perfect matchings of 2r points.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Moments of the prefix sums
providers.scope: tau(Q_m^r) = Cat_r m(m-1)...(m-r+1) + O_r(m^(r-1)) for Q_m = T_m T_m*.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Convergence to the limit law
providers.scope: The distributions of Q_m/m converge on bounded continuous functions to the law with density (1/2pi) sqrt((4-x)/x) on (0,4).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Little mass near zero
providers.scope: For every kappa > 0 there are d > 0 and m_0 with mu_m([0,d]) < kappa for m >= m_0.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A small cocycle with a prescribed word value
providers.scope: For n >= 3 and eta > 0 there are a word w and finitely supported real h with ||h|| < eta and ||D^h_w - delta_e|| < eta.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: One-step perturbation
providers.scope: A trace-preserving automorphism moves each A_j by less than eps while a word in the moved A_j comes within eps of C (n >= 3).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Lipschitz bounds for words
providers.scope: ||U_v - V_v||_2 <= |v| max_j ||U_j - V_j||_2 for unitary tuples, and the same in operator norm.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Consecutive free group factors (OpenAI)
providers.scope: L(F_n) and L(F_(n+1)) are isomorphic by a unital normal trace-preserving *-isomorphism for every n >= 3.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Free group factors of rank at least three
providers.scope: L(F_m) and L(F_n) are isomorphic for all integers 3 <= m <= n.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Composition, direct sums and isomorphisms in the Borel calculus
providers.scope: f(g(z)) = (f o g)(z) for bounded Borel f and g, the calculus of a direct sum is the direct sum, and normal isomorphisms commute with the calculus.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Haar generators
providers.scope: A self-adjoint element whose distribution function is continuous and strictly increasing on [a,b] generates the same von Neumann algebra as the Haar unitary exp(2 pi i F(y)).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Free group factors from free generators
providers.scope: Free von Neumann algebras each generated by a Haar unitary generate a copy of L(F_m).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The semicircle law
providers.scope: The Chebyshev polynomials U_n are orthonormal for the semicircle law; its image under t -> t^2 is the limit law nu with Catalan moments.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Associativity of freeness
providers.scope: Free families inside the members of a free family of groups form one free family.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A criterion for freeness
providers.scope: If L*dL = omega(d) for d in D, L* xi = 0 and L* D xi = 0, then L + L* is semicircular and free from D for the vector state of xi.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Creation operators and the other variables
providers.scope: l(g)* b l(g') = phi(b) <g', g> for b in the von Neumann algebra of the s(e), e orthogonal to g and g'.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Free semicircular families
providers.scope: s(e_1), ..., s(e_m) for an orthonormal basis are free semicircular for the vacuum, which is a faithful trace on their von Neumann algebra, and generate a copy of L(F_m).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Semicircular matrices
providers.scope: A 2x2 matrix with free semicircular diagonal and circular off-diagonal entries is semicircular for tr_2 (x) phi and free from M_2 of the algebra of the other variables.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Several semicircular matrices
providers.scope: Semicircular matrices on disjoint variables and M_2 of the remaining variables form a free family.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Circular elements
providers.scope: A circular element generates a copy of L(F_2), gamma* gamma has the limit law nu, the kernel is zero and the polar part is unitary.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Isomorphisms from equal distributions
providers.scope: Elements with the same *-distribution generate isomorphic von Neumann algebras, and the isomorphism carries polar decompositions.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Conjugation by a free Haar unitary
providers.scope: If v is a Haar unitary free from A, then P and vQv* are free for von Neumann subalgebras P, Q of A.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A free Haar unitary absorbs a unitary
providers.scope: If w is a Haar unitary free from A and v in A is unitary, then wv is a Haar unitary free from A.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Changing a free Haar basis
providers.scope: v_1, v_2 v_1*, ..., v_r v_1* are free Haar unitaries generating W*(v_1, ..., v_r).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Polar decomposition of a circular element (Voiculescu)
providers.scope: The polar part of a circular element is a Haar unitary free from its modulus.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Free families from semicircular matrices
providers.scope: Diagonal entries, polar parts and moduli of the circular entries of semicircular matrices on disjoint variables, together with the algebra of the remaining variables, form a free family.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Generators of a corner
providers.scope: pNp is generated by the elements a y b with y in a generating set, a in {p, W} and b in {p, W*}, for a partial isometry W from 1 - p to p.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Corners of trace one half
providers.scope: Corners by projections of equal trace are isomorphic, and R = M_2 (x) pRp when tau(p) = 1/2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Corner formula (Voiculescu)
providers.scope: p L(F_n) p and L(F_(4n-3)) are isomorphic for a projection p of trace 1/2 and n >= 2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Isomorphism of the free group factors (OpenAI)
providers.scope: L(F_2) and L(F_3) are isomorphic; hence L(F_m) and L(F_n) are isomorphic for all integers m, n >= 2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Corners and amplifications of L(F_2)
providers.scope: p L(F_2) p and M_2 (x) L(F_2) are isomorphic to L(F_2); 1/2 and 2 lie in its fundamental group.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Semicircular matrices of size k
providers.scope: A k x k matrix with free semicircular diagonal entries and circular entries above the diagonal, scaled by k^(-1/2), is semicircular for tr_k (x) phi and free from M_k of the algebra of the other variables.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Several semicircular matrices of size k
providers.scope: Semicircular matrices on disjoint blocks and M_k of the remaining variables form a free family; diagonal entries, polar parts and moduli of the circular entries, with the remaining variables, form a free family.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Generators of a corner with k matrix units
providers.scope: P_1 N P_1 is generated by W_p y W_q* for y in a generating set, given partial isometries W_q from P_q to P_1 with sum of the P_q equal to 1.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Matrix units in a II_1 factor
providers.scope: pRp is M_m(C) (x) q_1Rq_1 for m orthogonal equal-trace projections with sum p, and every projection is such a sum for every m.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Conjugation by several free Haar unitaries
providers.scope: If A, W*(v_2), ..., W*(v_k) are free with Haar v_q, then B_1, v_2R_2v_2*, ..., v_kR_kv_k* are free for subalgebras of A.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Corner formula for trace 1/k (Voiculescu)
providers.scope: p L(F_n) p and L(F_(1 + k^2(n-1))) are isomorphic for a projection p of trace 1/k, n >= 2, k >= 2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Rational corners of L(F_2)
providers.scope: Corners of L(F_2) by projections of rational trace, and M_m(C) (x) L(F_2), are isomorphic to L(F_2); every positive rational lies in its fundamental group.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
